description: The Building Data Genome 2 is an open dataset of 3,053 energy meters from 1,636 non-residential buildings, with hourly readings for two full years, 2016 and 2017, from electricity, heating and chilled water, steam and irrigation meters. Metadata describe each building's primary use and subcategory, industry and sub-industry, time zone and meter types, and weather data are included. A subset of 2,380 meters from 1,449 buildings was used in ASHRAE's Great Energy Predictor III machine learning competition on Kaggle in late 2019, for long-term prediction with application to measurement and verification; an overview paper describes the competition. Coverage: non-residential buildings at many anonymised sites. Access: meter, metadata and weather files and example notebooks in the GitHub repository, with documentation in its wiki. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0; free. Caveats: sites are anonymised and include data quality issues such as gaps and outliers that users must clean. Simulation uses are benchmarking load forecasting and anomaly detection methods and calibrating building energy models at scale. Related records: BuildingsBench and the LBNL Building Performance Database.
